summary: Bartow County entry on a Georgia lookout list, with location, elevation and a GFC code; no build date, staffing or fate in the sources.

evidence.supports: Bartow County; position; 903 ft (275 m) elevation; gfc-724 code
Cassville is an unincorporated community in Bartow County
evidence.quote: Cassville is an unincorporated community in Bartow County in the U.S. state of Georgia

evidence.supports: location between Adairsville and Cartersville, off U.S. Route 41
evidence.quote: Cassville lies in between Adairsville and Cartersville, off U.S. Route 41.

evidence.supports: area said to begin at the Cassville Road-Firetower Road intersection
evidence.quote: Cassville, although no longer incorporated, is said to encompass an area beginning at the Cassville Road-Firetower Road intersection and extending a mile in all directions.

evidence.supports: originally the county seat, when the county was named Cass
evidence.quote: It was originally the county seat before the name was changed from Cass County.

evidence.supports: seat moved to Cartersville after Sherman destroyed Cassville in 1864
evidence.quote: The seat was moved to Cartersville after General Sherman destroyed Cassville in his Atlanta campaign of 1864.

evidence.supports: station became full-time in 1981, having long been staffed entirely by volunteers
evidence.quote: Station 2 (Cassville) was opened as a full-time station in 1981 after a long history as an all-volunteer station.

corrections.why: The list gives the code as gfc-724; it has no US prefix.

notes_for_editor: Only the tnlandforms Georgia list places this tower (903 ft, Bartow County, gfc-724). Nothing found gives its build date, height, design, status, staffing or fire record, in two searches or the caches. Firetower Road (Cassville Road intersection; Station 2 at 130 Firetower Road) is a road name and a fire station address; no source ties either to a lookout, and the story now says no source ties the station to the lookout. The Bartow History Museum and Cassville Historical Society are the next places to check. Proposed correction: the record's GFC number 'US 724' should read 724.
